not_found.note: FSx for ONTAP FAQ answer to 'When should I use ONTAP vs other FSx types' only points to the 'Choosing an Amazon FSx file system' page (www/fsx/netapp-ontap/faqs line 65). No selection rule in the FAQ; the decisions lens must take it from www/fsx/when-to-choose-fsx. FAQ-stated ONTAP traits were added (protocols, Multi-AZ vs Single-AZ, tiering, SnapLock).

FSx for OpenZFS FAQ answer to 'When should I use OpenZFS vs other FSx types' only points to the Choosing page (www/fsx/openzfs/faqs line 53). No comparison against EFS in the FAQ. Added OpenZFS Multi-AZ/Single-AZ and Intelligent-Tiering choice rules instead.

EFS FAQ 'How many file systems, mount targets, or access points' only says 'Please visit the Amazon EFS Limits page' (www/efs/faq line 71): the counts are not in the FAQ, use the limits page (numbers lens). The 'How much data can I store' half is answered: petabytes (efs-faq-store-petabytes).

EFS FAQ latency/throughput/IOPS answer gives no numbers, only 'depends on its specific configuration' and a pointer to the File System Performance page (www/efs/faq line 73): numbers lens. Throughput modes half answered (Elastic default, Provisioned, the 5% rule).

source_disagreements_to_watch: EFS FAQ says NFS v4 (line 56) in one answer and NFS v4.1 (lines 148, 185) in others: both facts added (efs-faq-nfs-v4-protocol, efs-faq-onprem-mount-nfs-v4-1, efs-faq-locking-nfs-v4-1-advisory); check against the user guide.

FSx for Windows FAQ says up to 64 TB per file system (fsx-faq-windows-up-to-64-tb-per-file-system); the FSx Windows quotas page says Maximum storage capacity 64 TiB (unit differs: TB in FAQ, TiB in quotas). Writers should use the TiB value from the quotas page.
FSx for Windows FAQ says up to 12 GB/s and 350,000 IOPS; compare with the Windows user guide performance page.

FAQ pages say Intelligent-Tiering is 'currently available on Amazon FSx for OpenZFS' (OpenZFS FAQ) while the Lustre FAQ also lists an Intelligent-Tiering storage class: both added; check history pages for the dates.
Lustre FAQ states a 100 file systems per account limit; check the Lustre quotas page.
Typos kept verbatim in quotes: 'Service Message Block (SMB)' (Windows FAQ), 'Change to To access EFS file systems' (EFS on-premises answer).

Not examinable-yet check: the FSx for ONTAP and OpenZFS S3 Access Points answers and the Lustre/OpenZFS Intelligent-Tiering class need a date from the history pages before the chapter calls them examinable.
